fusions.name: Puffball Burst
fusions.desc: A cloud of venom spores bursts around you: every enemy within 3.5 tiles takes 26 poison damage, ignoring resistance, and becomes [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Body
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. The bite deals 18 poison damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Mound of Spores
fusions.desc: Raises a spore mound where you stand for 12 seconds. It puffs venom at an enemy within 3 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Skin
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on an enemy that is immune to them. Your poison resistance rises by 8%.
